topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: You'd think folks'd be more careful 'round here, hiding their gold in plain sight. Good thing it wasn't me who stumbled onto young Smith's little secret. Though, can't say I'm surprised. The way he's always got that car running smooth and his windows never fog up, even in the worst of the weather. I've seen the kind of work he does, too. Ain't no ordinary accounting job that pays for that kind of shine. Rich, is he? Well, he's got a fine cage for the bird he's trying to keep hidden. I just hope his neighbors are more honest than curious. Ain't nothing attracts trouble faster than a light that's left on in a dark alley.
